messages:
anya: Heads-up: onboarding reports that the JS sample app shows a raw stack for 403 and the Go sample prints "auth failed". New users can't tell if they need to refresh creds or ask for scopes.

lucy: This is classic DX friction. We need a single human-facing phrasing per intent and parity in SDK types.

sam: Proposal: canonical intents = authentication | authorization | rate_limit | conflict. Map to typed errors: AuthenticationError, PermissionDenied, RateLimitError, ConflictError.

raj: Important: 401 -> AuthenticationError (retryable: refresh token); 403 -> PermissionDenied (no retry); 429 -> RateLimitError (honor Retry-After). Copy must include a one-line hint.

marta: Docs should show both the SDK exception name and the exact UI text to display. Eg: "Permission denied: missing scope 'inference.write'. Grant the inference:write scope or use a key with that role."

owen: Minimal SDK mapper sketch (pseudo):
```
if status==401: raise AuthenticationError('token expired — refresh and retry')
elif status==403: raise PermissionDenied("missing scope 'inference.write'")
elif status==429: raise RateLimitError('quota exceeded — retry after')
```

anya: Also: quickstart auto-creates a key with only read scopes. New users try write flows and hit 403 immediately. Either broaden first-run scopes or make the error CTA explicit in the quickstart UI.

sam: I'll open a ticket with a mapping table + sampleapp patches and short snippets for catching/displaying typed errors in JS/Python/Go.

lucy: Add telemetry fields: error_intent and error_code so support can filter by intent rather than raw status. Keep original upstream body in logs.

raj: Security accepts normalizing noisy upstream bodies as long as we store original payload and trace id.

marta: Also add unit tests asserting that the user-facing message contains an actionable hint (assert contains 'refresh' or 'check scope' etc.).

devex-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-1899 "SDK error intent parity + sampleapp UX" assigned to @sam and @marta. https://tickets.example/DEVEX-1899

sam: Timeline: sampleapp + docs this sprint, SDK PRs next sprint. I'll ping SDK owners after the docs land.

anya: Thanks — should cut onboarding noise.
